name: When should I seek guidance for a pre-construction contract?

mainEntity.name: When should I seek guidance for a pre-construction contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to seek guidance as soon as you consider purchasing a pre-construction property, ideally before signing any reservation agreements or initial offers. Early engagement allows for a thorough review of the developer's terms and conditions from the outset. This preparation ensures you are well-informed about potential contingencies and financial obligations, such as deposit structures and construction schedules, preventing unexpected issues later. Acting early allows our team to identify and address any unfavorable clauses before they become binding, offering more leverage for negotiation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seek guidance for a pre-construction contract as soon as you consider buying, ideally before signing any reservation agreements or initial offers, to ensure thorough review and negotiation.
